title: An absorbed fix in a routing overlay is undeliverable by every dispatched role
description:
twa's whole fix is four kind cells of .tick/runners.cloud.toml, but the worker boundary exempts only .tick/config.md, .tick/runners.toml and .tick/learnings.md (internal/exec/subprocess/report.go:190), so every dispatched attempt of twa hits the same wall — the hn6 yjq shape, config edition. The yjq remedy (the tracker-edit proposal path) covers tracker records only, so there is no path by which the run's own machinery can land an overlay-cell fix: attempts burn the ladder answering BLOCKED while kkt and the final review wait on the flip. Either grow the boundary exemption to the routing overlays (an operator design call — the overlays are the model/price surface), or give findings an overlay-proposal path the run applies as it applies tracker edits, or leave overlay fixes to the operator on the PR — but then absorption should not create a dispatched tick for them.
evidence: internal/exec/subprocess/report.go:190-194 (exemptFromBoundary, no overlay); internal/reconcile/tracker_edits.go:18-21 (the yjq wall, tracker records only); .tick/issues/twa.json (the tick); .tick/issues/kkt.json (names twa's flip as A4's dependency); image/common.sh:215-216 (what the overlay's 'pi' does at boot)

ticfac run epic-43y filed this backlog tick from the finding a783c750c1d73fb2890a0dcdb804663341dcde321c4828c41a5f5d7e439cc649 (reported by run-epic-43y/tick-twa/attempt-31) instead of absorbing it: it was deferred past the absorption bound — absorbing it would be the 4th absorption of ONE chain that already carries 3 and the bound is 3 (tick qjj), so it is deferred past the absorption bound: a backlog tick with an owner, outside the epic, and the run carries on rather than recurse past the bound or halt for a person. Its verdict was that it gates done item A4 (basis predicted) — the bound wins, and the close-out and the final review see the deferral and can judge it. The chain: tick xd3 reported finding 270d4285800544591c8e0355a6fa723a7b0b7be030f568b1acf346e2e3d88a1f ("Name pi-durable in a hosted attempt's handle and the cloud profiles"), gates done item A1 and became tick 4uj; tick 4uj reported finding 1184d081f9b64334edc6ab6adc486f3d8456c69c3a9910574d3c7257be7a968c ("After jhp lands, name pi-durable in the cloud profiles and CloudRule.Harnesses"), gates done item A1 and became tick qf4; tick qf4 reported finding 0d02f47761197473c64809b5c88a0fea68f935562a62a2d21d49cd60973d61b9 (".tick/runners.cloud.toml still routes every cloud role to kind \"pi\""), gates done item A4 and became tick twa. Judge it with the epic's PR, and work it as ordinary backlog. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-43y/absorptions/a783c750c1d73fb2890a0dcdb804663341dcde321c4828c41a5f5d7e439cc649.json on the run branch.
